name: fdm_felix_food_double_common
machine_start_gcode:
; FELIX Food Twin - OrcaSlicer Start G-code - V1.00
M280 S1 ; Use 'S0' to turn Ditto off, use 'S1' to turn Ditto on
{if bed_temperature_initial_layer_single>0}M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
{endif}{if nozzle_temperature[0]>0}M104 S{nozzle_temperature[0]} T0
M104 S{nozzle_temperature[0]} T1
{endif}G28
G90
M82
M107
; =============== Prime routine ==================
G1 X10 Y10 Z10 F6000
M400
G92 E0
G1 E{2*retraction_length[0]+retract_restart_extra[0]+0.5} F15
G92 E0
G1 X{20+nozzle_diameter[0]*2} Y10 Z{nozzle_diameter[0]*0.5} F{travel_speed*60}
G1 X{40+nozzle_diameter[0]*2} Y10 E{nozzle_diameter[0]*initial_layer_print_height*20/((filament_diameter[0]/2)*(filament_diameter[0]/2)*3.14159)} F{initial_layer_speed*60}
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
; FELIX Food Twin - OrcaSlicer End G-code - V1.00
G92 E0
G1 E-{retraction_length[0]} F{retraction_speed[0]*60}
G92 E0
G91
G1 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
G28 Y
M107
M84
